name: efficiency-probe-1gpu
grid: 6 registry models x 4 contexts (4K/16K/32K/64K) = 24 cells, ONE GPU
what_it_produces: paper contribution 1: measured peak memory and throughput, inference_mode with an untimed warm-up, OOM kept as a row

three_defects_on_the_way_here.defect: IMPORT_ROOT was the scale package root, not the tree containing it
three_defects_on_the_way_here.why: the launcher prepends IMPORT_ROOT to sys.path and imports <root>/scale, so pointing it at the package itself makes the import look for <package>/scale
three_defects_on_the_way_here.found_by: running the launcher locally with DRY_RUN before trusting the submission

three_defects_on_the_way_here.defect: the new modules were never staged
three_defects_on_the_way_here.why: the staged tree had no experiments/nonlatent_iclr/efficiency, so the pod's import would have failed even with the right root
three_defects_on_the_way_here.found_by: listing the staged tree rather than assuming the copy step was enough

three_defects_on_the_way_here.defect: two scheduling failures before one succeeded
three_defects_on_the_way_here.why: job_fail_reserving: the scheduler assigned a node and could not reserve it, under contention from this program's own matrix holding 72 GPUs. The third attempt took it. This is a transient family, not a spec or command defect -- the job that succeeded used the identical body that failed
three_defects_on_the_way_here.found_by: reading the intermediate status rather than only the terminal one
